text:
clara: heads-up - onboarding smoke shows rerank failing when batch helper retries. getting 400s referencing vector length mismatch and duplicate rankings.

 diego: can you paste the runtime error + the exact outgoing payload from the client devtools?

 clara: runtime error:
 ```
 {"error":"bad_request","message":"vector length mismatch for item 2: expected 1536 got 1529"}
 ```
 client payload (trimmed):
 ```
 POST /v1/rerank
 {
   "vectors": [ [0.12,0.34,... /* end zeros missing */], [0.98,0.01,...] ],
   "query": "onboard steps"
 }
 ```

 monica: two separate root causes in this org's flows: 1) some sampleapps send a top-level "vectors" array rather than the runtime canonical "items: [{id,vector}]" shape; 2) one of our serializer optimizations removes trailing zeros when stringifying arrays (compact payload). When the batch helper deduplicates by index, the index->id mapping gets misaligned if a vector is shorter, causing retries to hit wrong items and appear duplicate.

 diego: repro steps I used: run sampleapp onboard flow under CPU throttling -> trigger rerank -> see 400 ~20% of runs. Captured HAR attached to the SDK issue.

 monica: immediate stopgap: a middleware in sampleapp that normalizes the request and pads vectors to the configured model dim (1536), also injects stable ids per item. snippet below:
 ```
 function normalize(body, dim=1536){
   const items = (body.vectors || []).map((v, i) => ({ id: `item-${i}`, vector: padTo(v, dim) }))
   return { items, query: body.query }
 }
 ```

 clara: sdk-bot: any PRs?

 sdk-bot: created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1302 - proposes options `preserveZeros` (default true) and `padVectors` (default false) plus cross-language parity tests. Also adds a pre-send validator in batch helper that throws if vector lengths vary and adds per-item idempotency keys so retries don't double-submit.

 diego: runtime ask: can we make the error message actionable? instead of just 400 give "expected=1536 got=1529 (item=2). Hint: check client serializer or header race" and include a debug header like X-Redwood-Vector-Debug: expected=1536;got=1529 so client teams see the mismatch faster.

 monica: QA will keep the sampleapp middleware until the SDK PR merges and then run end-to-end across Node, Browser, Android, iOS. I'll add a flaky test to catch serializer races.

 clara: filed ticket https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/1155 to track stopgap. leaving harvest logs and HAR in the ticket. thanks all :white_check_mark:
